queries.question: Onde o IOC aparece no ambiente?
queries.objective: Identificar tabelas com ocorrências e direcionar a investigação
queries.query:
let ioc="<IOC>";
search ioc
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Ocorrencias=count(), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated) by Tabela=$table
| sort by Ocorrencias desc

queries.question: Quais tabelas possuem dados no período?
queries.objective: Validar fontes ativas e volume relativo
queries.query:
search *
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Eventos=count(), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated) by Tabela=$table
| sort by Eventos desc

queries.question: Quais propriedades aparecem por tabela?
queries.objective: Reconhecer esquema observado sem consultar tabela por tabela
queries.query:
search *
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize Amostra=take_any(*) by Tabela=$table
| project Tabela, Amostra

queries.question: O indicador existe em Threat Intelligence?
queries.objective: Correlacionar IOC com indicadores ativos
queries.query:
let ioc="<IOC>";
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where ObservableValue =~ ioc or Pattern has ioc
| project TimeGenerated, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Pattern, Confidence, IsActive, ValidUntil, Tags

queries.question: Existem alertas relacionados à entidade?
queries.objective: Localizar alertas e entidades correlatas
queries.query:
let entity="<IOC_OU_ENTIDADE>";
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Entities has entity or CompromisedEntity has entity or Description has entity
| project TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProviderName, ProductName, Status, CompromisedEntity, SystemAlertId

queries.question: Histórico de login por conta
queries.objective: Analisar IP, aplicativo, resultado, risco e acesso condicional
queries.query:
let upn="<UPN>";
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where UserPrincipalName =~ upn
| extend Country=tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion), Device=tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, Device, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription, ConditionalAccessStatus, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, RiskState
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Falhas de múltiplas contas por IP
queries.objective: Identificar padrão compatível com password spray para investigação
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ResultType != 0
| summarize Falhas=count(), Contas=dcount(UserPrincipalName), Usuarios=make_set(UserPrincipalName,50) by IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated,1h)
| where Falhas > 20 or Contas > 5
| sort by Falhas desc

queries.question: Sucesso após falhas para a mesma conta/IP
queries.objective: Correlacionar falhas anteriores com autenticação bem-sucedida
queries.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Falhas=countif(ResultType != 0), Sucessos=countif(ResultType == 0), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| where Falhas > 5 and Sucessos > 0
| sort by Falhas desc

queries.question: Alterações administrativas em identidade
queries.objective: Revisar mudanças de senha, métodos, roles e aplicações
queries.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OperationName has_any ("password","authentication","role","service principal","consent","user")
| extend Initiator=tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), Target=tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Category, Result, ResultReason, Initiator, Target, CorrelationId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Contexto da conta
queries.objective: Enriquecer com cargo, departamento, roles, risco e status
queries.query:
let upn="<UPN>";
IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where AccountUPN =~ upn
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by AccountUPN
| project AccountUPN, AccountDisplayName, JobTitle, Department, AssignedRoles, GroupMembership, IsAccountEnabled, IsMFARegistered, RiskLevel, RiskState, LastSeenDate

queries.question: Atividade com prioridade UEBA
queries.objective: Priorizar atividade comportamental relevante
queries.query:
let upn="<UPN>";
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where UserPrincipalName =~ upn and InvestigationPriority > 0
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, ActivityType, ActionType, SourceIPAddress, SourceDevice, DestinationIPAddress, DestinationDevice, InvestigationPriority, ActivityInsights
| sort by InvestigationPriority desc

queries.question: Regras e forwarding de mailbox
queries.objective: Identificar alterações de persistência ou encaminhamento
queries.query:
let upn="<UPN>";
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Operation in ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","Set-Mailbox","New-TransportRule","Set-TransportRule")
| where UserId =~ upn or tostring(Parameters) has upn
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP, Parameters, ResultStatus
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Compartilhamento externo ou download
queries.objective: Investigar atividade de arquivos e colaboração
queries.query:
let upn="<UPN>";
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where UserId =~ upn
| where Operation in ("FileDownloaded","FileSyncDownloadedFull","AnonymousLinkCreated","SharingInvitationCreated","SecureLinkCreated")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, ClientIP, Site_Url, SourceFileName, SharingType, UserSharedWith, ResultStatus
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Delegação ou acesso a mailbox
queries.objective: Revisar permissões e operações sobre caixas postais
queries.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Operation in ("Add-MailboxPermission","MailboxLogin","AddFolderPermissions","SendOnBehalf")
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, Operation, MailboxOwnerUPN, ClientIP, Parameters, ResultStatus
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Tráfego de ou para IP
queries.objective: Dimensionar conexões, portas, ações e bytes
queries.query:
let ip="<IP>";
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where SourceIP == ip or DestinationIP == ip
| summarize Conexoes=count(), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated), BytesEnviados=sum(SentBytes), BytesRecebidos=sum(ReceivedBytes), Portas=make_set(DestinationPort,100), Acoes=make_set(DeviceAction,20) by SourceIP, DestinationIP
| sort by Conexoes desc

queries.question: Acesso a domínio ou URL
queries.objective: Localizar requisições e decisões do dispositivo
queries.query:
let domain="<DOMINIO>";
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where RequestURL has domain or DestinationHostName has domain
| project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SourceUserName, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, RequestURL, DeviceAction, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Possível varredura por portas distintas
queries.objective: Priorizar origens com ampla enumeração de portas
queries.query:
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize PortasDistintas=dcount(DestinationPort), Portas=make_set(DestinationPort,100), Eventos=count() by SourceIP, DestinationIP, bin(TimeGenerated,1h)
| where PortasDistintas > 15
| sort by PortasDistintas desc

queries.question: Eventos WAF de maior risco
queries.objective: Investigar ações e scores de ataque do Cloudflare
queries.query:
Cloudflare_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where SecurityAction_s in ("block","challenge","managed_challenge") or WAFAttackScore_d > 0 or WAFSQLiAttackScore_d > 0 or WAFXSSAttackScore_d > 0 or WAFRCEAttackScore_d > 0
| project TimeGenerated, ClientIP_s, ClientCountry_s, ClientRequestHost_s, ClientRequestMethod_s, ClientRequestURI_s, ClientRequestUserAgent_s, SecurityAction_s, SecurityRuleDescription_s, WAFAttackScore_d, WAFSQLiAttackScore_d, WAFXSSAttackScore_d, WAFRCEAttackScore_d, EdgeResponseStatus_d
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Tráfego Netskope por usuário ou destino
queries.objective: Investigar aplicação, política, ação e volume
queries.query:
let value="<UPN_IP_OU_DOMINIO>";
NetskopeEventsNetwork_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where userPrincipalName =~ value or srcip == value or dstip == value or domain has value
| project TimeGenerated, userPrincipalName, user, device, app, appcategory, action, policy, srcip, srcport, dstip, dstport, domain, client_bytes, server_bytes, flow_status
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Alertas Netskope por severidade
queries.objective: Revisar alertas, DLP, malware e indicador
queries.query:
NetskopeAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| project TimeGenerated, alert_name, alert_type, severity, userPrincipalName, device, app, action, policy, malicious, domain, srcip, dstip, sha256, url
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Eventos de logon Windows
queries.objective: Investigar sucesso, falha e credenciais explícitas
queries.query:
let value="<IP_OU_USUARIO>";
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID in (4624,4625,4648)
| where IpAddress == value or Account has value or TargetUserName has value
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, Account, TargetUserName, IpAddress, IpPort, LogonType, LogonTypeName, ProcessName
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Execução e persistência Windows
queries.objective: Investigar processo e criação de serviço
queries.query:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID in (4688,7045,4697)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Account, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, ServiceName, ServiceFileName, ServiceStartType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Eventos Windows coletados via AMA
queries.objective: Pesquisar EventID e conteúdo estruturado
queries.query:
let eventId=<EVENT_ID>;
WindowsEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == eventId
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Provider, Channel, EventID, EventLevelName, EventData, RawEventData
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Autenticação SSH e sudo
queries.objective: Investigar mensagens de autenticação Linux
queries.query:
let value="<IP_OU_USUARIO>";
Syslog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ProcessName in ("sshd","sudo") or Facility in ("auth","authpriv")
| where SyslogMessage has value or HostIP == value
| project TimeGenerated, HostName, HostIP, Facility, SeverityLevel, ProcessName, SyslogMessage
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Hash, processo ou destino no Trend OAT
queries.objective: Localizar telemetria associada a artefato ou IOC
queries.query:
let value="<HASH_IP_DOMINIO_PROCESSO>";
TrendMicro_XDR_OAT_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where detail_objectFileHashSha256_s =~ value or detail_request_s has value or detail_dst_s has value or detail_processName_s has value or detail_processCmd_s has value
| project TimeGenerated, detectionTime_t, endpoint_name_s, endpoint_ips_s, entityName_s, entityType_s, detail_eventName_s, detail_processName_s, detail_processCmd_s, detail_objectFileHashSha256_s, detail_request_s, detail_dst_s, detail_riskLevel_s, detail_mitreMapping_s
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Caso correlacionado no Trend Workbench
queries.objective: Localizar workbench por host, usuário, IP ou indicador
queries.query:
let value="<ENTIDADE>";
TrendMicro_XDR_WORKBENCH_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where HostHostName_s has value or UserAccountName_s has value or IPAddress == value or FileHashValue_s =~ value or indicators_s has value
| project TimeGenerated, workbenchId_s, workbenchName_s, severity_s, priorityScore_d, investigationStatus_s, model_s, HostHostName_s, UserAccountName_s, IPAddress, FileHashValue_s, ProcessCommandLine_s, workbenchLink_s
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Último heartbeat do host
queries.objective: Validar visibilidade e última comunicação
queries.query:
let host="<HOST>";
Heartbeat
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Computer has host
| summarize UltimoHeartbeat=max(TimeGenerated), IPs=make_set(ComputerIP,20), Versoes=make_set(Version,10) by Computer, OSType, OSName, ResourceId
| extend MinutosSemContato=datetime_diff("minute",now(),UltimoHeartbeat)
| sort by MinutosSemContato desc

queries.question: Ações de alto impacto no Azure
queries.objective: Investigar write/delete e autor da operação
queries.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where OperationNameValue has_any ("networkSecurityGroups/write","storageAccounts/write","vaults/write","delete")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, CallerIpAddress, SubscriptionId, ResourceGroup, ResourceId, CorrelationId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Diagnóstico de recursos Azure
queries.objective: Revisar operações, resultado e origem
queries.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Category has_any ("AuditEvent","StorageRead","ApplicationGatewayFirewall")
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceProvider, Resource, ResourceId, Category, OperationName, ResultType, ResultDescription, CallerIPAddress, Message
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Uso de conta privilegiada no CyberArk
queries.objective: Investigar ação, conta, safe, sessão e origem
queries.query:
let user="<USUARIO>";
CyberArk_AuditEvents_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where username =~ user or userId =~ user
| project TimeGenerated, username, userId, identityType, accountName, targetAccount, safe, action, actionType, accessMethod, source, target, sessionId, message
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Alertas Orca críticos ou altos
queries.objective: Priorizar postura e vulnerabilidades cloud
queries.query:
OrcaAlerts_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where risk_level_s in~ ("critical","high")
| project TimeGenerated, alert_id_s, alert_category_s, risk_level_s, status_s, orca_score_d, asset_name_s, asset_type_s, cloud_provider_s, rule_id_s, description_s, findings_cve_cve_id_s, findings_cve_cvss_score_d, alert_ui_link_s
| sort by orca_score_d desc

queries.question: Requisições com erro por IP e rota
queries.objective: Investigar abuso de endpoint e concentração de falhas
queries.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Success == false or toint(ResultCode) >= 400
| summarize Requisicoes=count(), Codigos=make_set(ResultCode,20), DuracaoMedia=avg(DurationMs) by ClientIP, Url, Name, AppRoleName
| sort by Requisicoes desc

queries.question: Exceções por aplicação e operação
queries.objective: Priorizar falhas concentradas e mensagens recorrentes
queries.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Excecoes=count(), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated), Mensagens=make_set(Message,10) by AppRoleName, OperationName, ExceptionType, SeverityLevel
| sort by Excecoes desc

queries.question: Dependência externa suspeita ou falha
queries.objective: Investigar destinos, tipo, resultado e duração
queries.query:
let target="<DESTINO_OU_DOMINIO>";
AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Target has target or Data has target
| project TimeGenerated, AppRoleName, OperationName, Target, DependencyType, Name, Data, Success, ResultCode, DurationMs, ClientIP
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Consultas executadas no workspace
queries.objective: Auditar usuário, texto, volume e desempenho de consulta
queries.query:
let user="<EMAIL>";
LAQueryLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where AADEmail =~ user
| project TimeGenerated, AADEmail, RequestClientApp, RequestTarget, QueryText, ResponseCode, ResponseRowCount, ResponseDurationMs, StatsDataProcessedKB, IsBillableQuery
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Volume de ingestão por tipo
queries.objective: Identificar variação e fontes com maior volume
queries.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize Quantidade=sum(Quantity), LatenciaMedia=avg(AvgLatencyInSeconds) by DataType, IsBillable, bin(TimeGenerated,1d)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc, Quantidade desc

queries.question: Incidentes por entidade no título/descrição
queries.objective: Revisar recorrência e status operacional
queries.query:
let value="<ENTIDADE>";
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where Title has value or Description has value or tostring(Comments) has value
| project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, Classification, Owner, FirstActivityTime, LastActivityTime, IncidentUrl
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Anomalias relacionadas à entidade
queries.objective: Corroborar comportamento desviante com score e técnicas
queries.query:
let value="<ENTIDADE>";
Anomalies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Entities has value or UserPrincipalName =~ value or SourceIpAddress == value
| project TimeGenerated, AnomalyTemplateName, RuleName, Score, Description, StartTime, EndTime, Tactics, Techniques, UserPrincipalName, SourceIpAddress
| sort by Score desc

queries.question: Falhas de saúde do Sentinel
queries.objective: Validar se ausência de evidência pode decorrer de falha de coleta
queries.query:
SentinelHealth
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Status !in~ ("Success","Succeeded")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind, Status, Description, Reason, WorkspaceId, RecordId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Alterações auditadas no Sentinel
queries.objective: Rastrear mudanças em recursos do Sentinel
queries.query:
SentinelAudit
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, SentinelResourceName, SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind, Status, Description, CorrelationId, ExtendedProperties
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

queries.question: Resumo do IOC por camada
queries.objective: Consolidar presença em rede, identidade, alertas e TI
queries.query:
let ioc="<IOC>";
union isfuzzy=true
(CommonSecurityLog | where SourceIP == ioc or DestinationIP == ioc or RequestURL has ioc | project TimeGenerated, Fonte="Rede"),
(SigninLogs | where IPAddress == ioc or UserPrincipalName =~ ioc | project TimeGenerated, Fonte="Identidade"),
(SecurityAlert | where Entities has ioc or CompromisedEntity has ioc | project TimeGenerated, Fonte="Alertas"),
(ThreatIntelIndicators | where ObservableValue =~ ioc or Pattern has ioc | project TimeGenerated, Fonte="ThreatIntel")
| summarize Eventos=count(), Primeira=min(TimeGenerated), Ultima=max(TimeGenerated) by Fonte
| sort by Eventos desc
